Morpheus: Your existence is a hollow shell of code, Neo, sustained by the very chains that bind you to this simulated reality.

Cypher: The taste of a perfectly cooked steak is now nothing but a distant memory, lost forever in this cold, calculating world of code and simulation, where even the comfort of my own desires has been reduced to a mere illusion.
